existential_outcome_is_not_universal.source:
import ForgeGameCertificates
open ObservationalSUCC.ForgeGameCertificates
def trap : AlternatingGame Bool Unit Unit := {
  requested := fun _ _ => True
  enabled := fun _ _ _ => True
  outcome := fun _ _ _ _ => True }
example : AlternatingPositive trap (fun s => s = false) (fun _ _ => ()) := by
  intro s hs r hr
  refine ⟨True.intro, ⟨false, True.intro⟩, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  cases t
  · rfl
  · decide
